caption:
You can now just talk to your inbox. ChatGPT's Live Voice can check your calendar, summarize Slack, or draft an email reply — out loud, no typing.

It's also new in ChatGPT Work: draft docs, decks and sheets by voice.

Live on web, iOS and Android now.

Save this for how to try it.

📷 Photo: Steve Jurvetson · CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

#chatgpt #openai #voiceai #aitools #productivity #ai #genai

slides.title: ChatGPT's Live Voice can now use your apps while you talk.
slides.sub: Check your calendar, summarize Slack, or draft an email reply — out loud.
slides.voiceover: ChatGPT's voice mode can now use your connected apps while you talk.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: Voice, plugged into your apps
items: Now works with your connected apps mid-conversation
Email (Google & Microsoft), calendar, Slack and more
slides.voiceover: OpenAI rolled it out on web, iOS and Android on September 23rd.

slides.label: Say it, don't type it
slides.title: What you can ask Live Voice
items: "Draft a reply to that message from Sam"
slides.voiceover: Ask it to check your calendar or summarize your Slack channel.

slides.label: How to try it
slides.title: Getting started
steps: Sign in to email, calendar or Slack in ChatGPT once
Open Voice and just start talking
Ask for the app by name
slides.voiceover: Connect the app once, then just ask for it by name in Live.

slides.label: Also new
slides.title: Voice comes to ChatGPT Work
items: Codex and the ChatGPT desktop app
It keeps going in text after you stop talking
slides.voiceover: Voice also landed in ChatGPT Work — you can draft docs by talking.

slides.label: Keep in mind
slides.title: Good to know
items: Actions that need approval show on-screen — there's no voice approval
Your existing app permissions and workspace rules still apply
Free and Go users get Voice with the plugins their plan already supports
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool news
slides.voiceover: Anything needing your approval shows on screen, never by voice alone.

slides.title: Your voice assistant
slides.voiceover: That's ChatGPT Voice with connected apps — your assistant just got hands.
